assumptions.choice: Donchian upper/lower bands are computed as Highest(high,20)/Lowest(low,20) but referenced with a one-bar delay (previous 20 bars, excluding the current bar) when testing the crossover condition.
assumptions.reason: A band that includes the current bar's own high/low always satisfies band>=close, making a 'close crosses above the band' event logically impossible; comparing close to the channel formed by prior bars is the standard, literal reading that lets the stated breakout condition ever occur.

assumptions.choice: Contraction (channel width < 2*ATR) is evaluated at the same prior-bar reference point (index -1) as the Donchian band used for the crossover.
assumptions.reason: Spec does not fix the exact timing of the contraction check relative to the breakout signal; aligning it with the same reference bar as the band keeps 'after contraction' self-consistent with the crossover comparison.

assumptions.choice: On an opposite breakout signal, only self.close() is called; the opposite position is not opened on the same bar, and is only entered later once flat and the entry condition independently fires again.
assumptions.reason: The spec states exit and entry as separate rules, and the canonical default forbids re-entry while a position is open; a same-bar stop-and-reverse was not explicitly stated.

assumptions.choice: Interpreted 'medium risk parameters' as already reflected in the stated periods (20/14) and 2xATR stop multiplier; used plain self.buy()/self.sell() with default sizing.
assumptions.reason: Spec gives no separate numeric risk/sizing parameter beyond what is already stated, per canonical default 1.

assumptions.choice: The ATR value used to set the stop-loss distance is the ATR on the bar the entry order fills (in notify_order), not the bar the signal was generated.
assumptions.reason: Most direct literal reading of 'stop-loss at 2xATR from entry price' ties the ATR to the moment of entry.
